title: Sales Internship in Pimpri, Navi Mumbai, Pimpri-Chinchwad, Pune (Hybrid)
Business Development & Lead Generation Internship in Pimpri, Pimpri-Chinchwad, Pune
description:
Are you confident, energetic, and comfortable communicating with people?
   

  

 Looking to gain real\-world experience in B2B sales, business development, and lead generation while working on live campaigns for IT and technology companies?
   

  

 LeadNexus is looking for enthusiastic Business Development \& Lead Generation Interns to join our team in Pune.
   

  

 This is a great opportunity for freshers and students looking to build strong communication, sales, and professional skills.
   

  

**Selected Intern's Day\-to\-day Responsibilities Include**
* Make outbound calls to business professionals and key decision\-makers.
* Introduce relevant industry whitepapers, expert sessions, and webinars to prospective participants.
* Understand prospects' requirements and identify relevant opportunities.
* Generate and qualify B2B leads based on campaign requirements.
* Encourage qualified prospects to participate in expert calls and webinars.
* Follow up with interested prospects to improve lead conversion and event attendance.
* Maintain accurate daily records of calls, leads, follow\-ups, and conversions.
* Work towards daily and weekly calling and lead\-generation targets.
* Coordinate with the internal team to ensure consistent, high\-quality lead generation.


 About Company: Lead Nexus is a creative branding and social media agency dedicated to helping brands build a strong and meaningful presence in the digital world. We believe that a powerful visual identity and clear communication are the foundation of every successful brand.
